items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1960-01-25
items.q: The interviewer mentions Wilhelmina Ball; the interviewee does not respond with any personal connection or knowledge of her.

ctx.x: I don't find him. Uh, Andrew Anderson told me he saw him just recently. Andrew Anderson, he come from the same place too. He don't play anymore.
You know who's over there too, is Wilhelmina Ball. He says Wilhelmina Ball is over there in Lacombe. We'll have to take a trip over there Bill.
Uh huh. Uh, what did those bands play for? Mostly dances or parties or on a boat or anything?
